name: Cutaway Section
desc: An endless architectural cross-section trucking sideways forever — storeys stacked over a cut grade line, poché-black structure driving down through topsoil, gravel, clay and bedrock to a service tunnel, lit windows breathing in every room.

energy.doc: window glow, tunnel light, vertical camera lift

scale.doc: storey height and slab thickness — at max the building swallows the earth

density.doc: structural bays across the frame (narrower bays = more rooms)

speed.doc: sideways truck rate along the section

hue.doc: earth / material hue (sky takes the complement)

x.doc: anchor into the endless section (phase offset along x)

y.doc: grade line height as canvas fraction — balance of building against earth

style.doc: aesthetic: architect's section with solid poché cut / vivid stratigraphic survey plate / cyan schematic on navy / dark X-ray with only glowing edges / two-ink risograph with halftone earth and a misregistered plate

seed.doc: deterministic seed for rooms, strata undulation, roof plant and services
